decision.hypothesis: The car needs a clockwise yaw (north toward northeast) to align with the road; continued W+D should complete that rotation and put it on the asphalt.
decision.memory: In north-up views W+D curves the nose clockwise. The road bearing here is up-right; the car must get moving faster for steering to take effect.
